purpose: Reconciles the 20 Customization Unlock Keys against partner identity, DLC ownership, and update-history evidence without treating key possession as ownership of DLC.
source_policy: Official Bandai Namco material establishes Partner Customize as a feature unlocked through Customize Unlock Keys from Raid Boss Battles. Community reference material supplies the current 1-20 mapping and DLC associations; those associations are retained as community-sourced unless independently confirmed.

sources.scope: Partner Customize feature and Raid Boss Battle key acquisition
20-key mapping, DLC associations, and unlock scope
Partner Customization options and key mapping
reported update grouping for keys 1-10, 11-15, and 16-20

records.identity_note: Source naming varies between Trunks and Future Trunks; canonical roster identity must remain explicit.

mechanical_facts.key_source: Raid Boss Battles / Online Raid Quests
mechanical_facts.unlock_scope: The key unlocks the corresponding partner for Partner Customization; the documented base unlock includes the partner's base skills, balanced stats, and assigned Super Soul, while additional options can require TP Medals.
mechanical_facts.dlc_rule: A key can be obtained independently of DLC ownership, but the corresponding DLC character may remain unavailable for Partner Customization until the required content is owned.

historical_note: Community sources report three introduction groups: keys 1-10 with the 1.15 update, 11-15 with the 1.17 update, and 16-20 with the 1.19 update. These version associations are retained as community-reported history rather than promoted to fully verified official chronology.
